skillPacks.title: Superpowers Essentials
skillPacks.blurb: Five battle-tested software-development methodology skills from obra/superpowers: brainstorm before building, debug by root cause, write step-by-step plans, take code review with rigor, and prove work is done before claiming it.
skillPacks.blurbZh: obra/superpowers 精选的五条软件开发方法论:动手前先构思、按根因调试、写分步计划、以技术严谨对待评审、宣称完成前先拿证据。

commandPreviews.name: brainstorming
commandPreviews.description: Explore before building: divergent ideas, cross-domain analogies, assumption checks
commandPreviews.descriptionZh: 动手前先构思:发散探索、跨域类比、假设盘点

commandPreviews.name: systematic-debugging
commandPreviews.description: Debug by root cause, not by patching symptoms

commandPreviews.name: writing-plans

commandPreviews.name: receiving-code-review
commandPreviews.description: Treat review feedback with technical rigor — verify before implementing
commandPreviews.descriptionZh: 以技术严谨对待评审意见,先验证再实现

commandPreviews.name: verification-before-completion

skillPacks.title: Vercel Web Review
skillPacks.blurb: Vercel’s web-design-guidelines skill reviews accessibility, performance and interface quality. It reads your selected files and fetches current official guidelines online; the full React skills collection is not included.
skillPacks.blurbZh: 精选 Vercel 网页审查技能，检查无障碍、性能与界面体验。需要读取所选文件并联网获取官方规则；不包含完整 React 技能合集。

skillPacks.title: Trail of Bits Audit Prep
skillPacks.titleZh: Trail of Bits 审计准备
skillPacks.blurb: Trail of Bits’ audit-prep-assistant helps define review scope, check test coverage and prepare audit documentation. Uses workspace tools; language-specific analyzers are separate dependencies. This is audit preparation, not a security certification.
skillPacks.blurbZh: 精选 Trail of Bits 审计准备技能，整理审查范围、测试覆盖和审计文档。需要工作区工具，专用分析器需另行配置；使用该技能不代表通过安全认证。

commandPreviews.name: audit-prep-assistant
commandPreviews.description: Prepare scope, coverage evidence and documentation for a security review.
commandPreviews.descriptionZh: 准备安全审查范围、覆盖率证据和项目文档。

skillPacks.title: Ponytail
skillPacks.blurb: Four coding skills for simpler implementations, over-engineering reviews, repository audits and shortcut tracking. Invoke manually; no automatic hooks or MCP server. Complexity reviews do not replace security review.
skillPacks.blurbZh: 四个编程技能：简化实现、检查过度设计、审计仓库复杂度、整理技术债。手动调用，不安装自动钩子或 MCP 服务；复杂度评审不能替代安全审查。

skillPacks.title: Doc Co-Authoring
skillPacks.blurb: Anthropic's three-stage workflow for proposals, decision docs and specs: gather context, build each section by brainstorming and curation, then test the draft on a reader. In PuPu the draft lives in a markdown file in your workspace, written and revised through the write/edit tools with your confirmation; context comes from what you paste or from MCP servers you installed; reader testing is manual — open a new PuPu chat and paste the document. Your selected model does the work at its usual cost. Unverified; instruction only. PuPu does not bundle the skill body; it downloads from upstream when you install. The license for this specific skill is not specified upstream.
skillPacks.blurbZh: Anthropic 官方的三阶段文档协作流程：先收集背景，再逐节头脑风暴并筛选成稿，最后让读者试读找盲点。在 PuPu 中草稿保存为工作区的 markdown 文件，通过 write/edit 工具写入和修改并需要你确认；背景来自你粘贴的内容或已安装的 MCP 服务；读者测试需手动在新会话中粘贴文档进行。由你选择的模型执行，按其正常计费。未经验证，仅含指令。PuPu 不捆绑技能正文；安装时才从上游下载。上游未注明此技能的具体许可证。
